独立音轨超过 32 条，请选择混合音轨。: More than 32 separate tracks. Export mixed audio.
无法在导出目录创建临时目录。: Cannot create a temporary folder in the export directory.
正在封装音轨、字幕和章节…: Packaging audio tracks, captions and chapters…
请先导入待混剪的素材。: Import the clips for the montage.
源工程已标记为必保。: The source project marks this range as required.
请用 1 到 %1 个字符说明需要的片段。: Describe the desired clips in 1 to %1 characters.
视频模型没有找到符合要求的高光。: The video model found no highlights matching the request.
多素材工程已改变，请重新生成混剪草稿。: The sequence changed. Generate a new montage draft.
选段超出原素材的保留范围，或包含已删区间。: The clip extends beyond retained footage or includes a deleted range.
请在草稿中勾选 1 至 %1 个片段。: Select 1 to %1 clips in the draft.
草稿需要保留源工程的必保区间。: Include the required ranges from the source project.
无法读取混剪草稿。: Could not read the montage draft.
按要求读取描述中的成片时长。填 0 秒表示不限。: Use the duration in the request. Set to 0 seconds for no limit.
每段素材提供的候选上限，实际数量取决于找到的动作。: Maximum candidates per source. The result depends on the events found.
混剪目标时长需在 0 到 24 小时之间。: Target duration must be between 0 and 24 hours.
请选择自动采样或 1 至 %1 FPS。: Choose automatic sampling or 1 to %1 FPS.
自动以 %1 FPS 扫描，再以 %2 FPS 复核重点区域。数字档使用固定帧率: Automatic mode scans at %1 FPS, then reviews key areas at %2 FPS. Numeric settings use a fixed sampling rate.
有 %1 个区域未完成复核，初筛候选可继续查看。: %1 regions could not be reviewed. The initial suggestions are still available.
必保区间已超过成片最多能保留的 %1 个片段。: Protected ranges exceed the output limit of %1 clips.
找出每局的反击和终结，剪成约 35 秒: Find each round's counters and finishers for a 35-second montage
有 %1 段素材未找到符合要求的高光。请核对其余片段。: No matching highlights in %1 sources. Review the remaining clips.
草稿已生成。选中片段可回看依据。: Draft ready. Select a clip to review its evidence.
无法创建混剪预览目录。: Could not create the montage preview folder.
按草稿顺序应用 %1 个片段（%2）到当前多素材工程？: Apply %1 clips (%2) in draft order to this sequence?
混剪草稿已应用。可继续调整或保存工程。: Draft applied. Continue editing or save the sequence.
模型正在分析第 %1 / %2 段素材…: The model is analyzing source %1 of %2…
正在准备第 %1 / %2 段视频样本…: Preparing video samples for source %1 of %2…
用所选录像生成混剪: Create a montage from selected recordings
请选择至少两段要混剪的录像。: Select at least two recordings for the montage.
开启后可在悬浮条暂停、停止和打点。: Use the floating bar to pause, stop, and add markers.
无法创建保存目录，请检查路径和文件夹权限。: Could not create the recording folder. Check the path and folder permissions.
默认目录无法写入，本次保存到：%1: The default folder is not writable. Saving to %1.
无法写入保存目录：%1\n%2\n请在“存储与倒计时”中选择可写文件夹。:
Cannot write to the recording folder: %1
%2
Choose a writable folder in Storage & countdown.
填写相关条件即可。提示词会先放入输入框，由你检查并发送。: Fill in the relevant fields. Review the prompt before sending it.
相对日期或起止日期: Relative dates or a start and end date
要找的动作、事件或画面: Actions, events, or scenes to look for
素材数量、顺序、原声等，选填: Optional clip count, order, or original audio preferences
在哪一步出现了什么问题: Describe the step and what happened
错误文字或编码器名称，选填: Optional error text or encoder name
格式、编码器、独立音轨等，选填: Optional format, encoder, or separate tracks
输入中英旁白，先试听，再与当前剪辑后的画面合成。: Enter narration in Chinese or English, preview it, then mix it with the edited video.
朗读文字会发给 %1。可直接输入服务支持的音色 ID。: Narration text is sent to %1. Enter a voice ID supported by that service.
未找到 Audio8 运行包。请打开“本地模型目录”。: Audio8 is unavailable. Open Local model folder to locate it.
Windows 尚未安装此语言的语音。: Windows has no installed voice for this language.
当前模型在本机合成。点击扬声器可试听音色。: This model runs locally. Click the speaker to hear a sample.
旁白文字或音色已变更，请重新生成试听。: The narration or voice has changed. Generate a new preview.
输入服务音色 ID，可留默认: Enter a voice ID or use the default
Audio8 按句加载。较长句子可能需要几十秒。: Audio8 runs one line at a time. Longer lines may take several seconds.
还未配置 Audio8 本地运行包，请打开“本地模型目录”。: Audio8 is unavailable. Open Local model folder to locate it.
请选择包含 Python、runtime、model 和 voices 的完整运: Choose the complete package with Python, runtime, model, and voices.
选填，可在配音时修改: Optional; can be changed when dubbing
留空表示不发送密钥: Leave blank to send no API key
例如 Bearer 加一个空格；也可留空: For example, Bearer followed by a space, or leave blank
例如 result.0.text；留空读取整个 JSON: For example result.0.text; leave blank to read the whole JSON
变量写成完整的 JSON 字符串值：$model、$text、$voice、$l: Use variables as entire JSON string values: $model, $text, $voice, $language, $speed, $format, $sample_rate.
变量写成完整的 JSON 字符串值：$model、$messages、$tool: Use variables as entire JSON string values: $model, $messages, $tools, $tool_choice, $text, $system, $media, $video_data, $request.
如服务需要，请填写密钥: Enter a key if the service requires one
检验使用当前填写的配置，只发送测试数据。保存后才应用到录屏工具。: Checks use the current form and send test data only. Save to apply the profile.
配音配置已满，请修改现有配置。: Voice profiles are full. Edit an existing profile.
正在发送测试数据并检验服务能力…: Sending test data to check the service…
通过：模型能调用工具并读取工具结果。: Passed: The model can call a tool and read its result.
通过：模型返回了可用的中英双向译文。: Passed: The model translated both ways between Chinese and English.
通过：模型识别了视觉样本并返回带时间点的结果。: Passed: The model understood the visual samples and returned a timestamp.
通过：服务返回的配音可解码播放。: Passed: The supplied speech can be decoded and played.
未找到接口或模型，请检查完整接口地址和模型名。: Endpoint or model not found. Check the full URL and model name.
服务不接受此请求，请检查接口协议、模型输入能力与参数。: The service rejected the request. Check the API protocol, supported inputs, and parameters.
未找到 Audio8 运行包。请在配音窗口选择本地模型目录。: Audio8 is unavailable. Choose its local model folder in the dubbing window.
没有此接口的 API 密钥。请填写密钥，或在免鉴权服务中留空认证头。: No API key is configured for this URL. Enter a key, or clear the header for services that do not need authentication.
当前功能不支持所选接口协议。: This feature does not support the chosen protocol.
请求模板需要是非空 JSON 对象。: The request template must be a non-empty JSON object.
服务返回的内容与所选接口不匹配，请检查协议和响应字段。: The response does not match this protocol. Check the protocol and response field.
认证头、前缀或密钥格式无效。: Invalid authentication header, prefix, or key.
响应路径请用点分隔字段或数组下标，例如 result.0.text。: Separate field names or array indices with dots, for example result.0.text.
请选择配音服务的音频返回格式。: Choose the audio format returned by the voice service.
配音响应没有可解码的音频。请检查音色、响应字段和音频格式。: The response contains no decodable audio. Check the voice, response field, and format.
服务未返回预期的英语译文。: The service did not return an English translation.
服务未返回预期的中文译文。: The service did not return a Chinese translation.
可以连接，但模型没有按要求返回工具调用。请选支持工具调用的模型。: The connection works, but the model did not call the tool. Choose a model that supports tool calls.
模型未能读取工具结果并生成答复。: The model did not read the tool result and reply.
无法创建能力检验临时目录。: Could not create the capability check folder.
返回内容无法解码为可播放的音频。: The response could not be decoded into playable audio.
无法生成能力检验视频。: Could not create the test video.
无法读取能力检验视频。: Could not read the test video.
无法生成能力检验图片。: Could not create the test image.
模型没有正确识别样本画面，或未返回带时间点的剪辑结果。: The model misidentified the sample or did not return a timestamp.
高采样率使用的抽帧列表检验未通过。: High sampling rate frame list check failed.
当前程序以受限权限运行，无法写入 %1（%2）。请从 Windows 开始菜单或: This copy is running with restricted permissions and cannot write to %1 (%2). Launch the installed WPS Recorder from the Windows Start menu or the user programs folder.
Anthropic Messages 收到了无效的抽帧图片。: The Anthropic Messages request contains an invalid sampled image.
Anthropic Messages 需要文字或图片，请检查模型服务的输入。: Anthropic Messages accepts text or images. Check the input configured for this service.
Anthropic Messages 使用带时间点的抽帧图片进行视频分析。: Anthropic Messages analyzes video using sampled images with timestamps.
填写 Anthropic 接口地址、模型 ID 和 API 密钥，再检验能力。: Enter the Anthropic endpoint URL, model ID, and API key, then check the service.
输入最多 4000 字的旁白…: Enter up to 4,000 characters of narration…
已生成 %1 秒旁白。可试听或加入时间轴。: Narration is %1 seconds long. Preview it or add it to the timeline.
起点在已剪掉的画面中，请选择一个保留区间。: The start is in a cut section. Choose a point in a kept section.
旁白到 %1，超出源片结尾。请提前起点、缩短稿件或加快语速。: Narration ends at %1, after the source ends. Move it earlier, shorten the script or increase the speed.
配音轨已生成。应用到时间轴后可剪切和调整音量。: The voiceover track is ready. Apply it to trim it or adjust its volume.
可离线识别生成字幕，导入 SRT，或直接填写旁白。: Use offline transcription, import an SRT or enter a narration script.
输入旁白稿，生成后可试听并加入时间轴。: Enter a script, generate the narration, then preview or add it to the timeline.
无法保存配音。请检查应用数据目录。: Could not save the voiceover. Check the application data folder.
字幕已应用。配音轨待更新，可在字幕与配音中重做。: Subtitles applied. Rebuild the voiceover track in Subtitles and voiceover.
改动已应用到时间轴。保存剪辑工程可继续编辑。: Changes applied to the timeline. Save the project to edit it later.
摄像头超时，请检查设备后重新检查。: The camera stopped responding. Check the device and retry.
桌面复制返回空画面，已切换到兼容采集。: Desktop duplication returned a blank frame. Using compatible capture.
当前桌面画面全黑。请打开有内容的窗口，再重新检查。: The desktop preview is black. Open a window with visible content and check again.
请在服务设置中配置视频理解模型。: Configure a video model in Service settings.
请在模型服务中配置字幕翻译。: Configure subtitle translation in Model services.
请选择要删除的配音配置。: Select the voice profile to delete.
选择现有配置，在下方编辑后保存。: Select a profile, edit its fields below, and save.
选填，留空使用模型名称: Optional. Defaults to the model name.
新增一项配音配置后即可填写接口。: Add a voice profile to enter its API details.
删除「%1」及此配置保存的密钥？: Delete “%1” and its saved API keys?
